description: Four plastic bowls sit on a green bedspread in front of a large purple pillow: light blue, lavender, orange, and dark gray. The left hand reaches forward to grasp and lift the orange bowl while the right hand steadies the dark gray bowl; the left hand nests the orange bowl into the gray one, then picks up the lavender bowl and stacks it on top, followed by placing the light blue bowl on top to make a neat stack.
